transfer_validation.paper_use: limited transfer evidence / operational feasibility only; not proof of cross-domain generalization; not a trading strategy

limitations: Human Gate 未完成，当前结果不是正式验证结果。
Transfer 仅为结构迁移演示，不支持交易优势。
不推断因果 AIV、长期能力或学生排名。

robustness_validation.description: development-stage structural stability and controlled parameter variants; no causal counterfactuals; formal student-level ranking is NOT_APPLICABLE

post_processing.core_artifact: outputs/final_results.json is the canonical M0/M3 numerical source; no experiment rerun in this repair.
post_processing.figures: reports/visual_evidence/final/ figures are existing development-only renderings linked by the artifact.
post_processing.demo: reports/demo/demo_payload.json and submission-package demo payload are aligned to M0 Raw and M3 default; HTML is presentation-only.
post_processing.paper: paper/submission_candidate.md and paper/development_submission_candidate.md consume the same frozen development numbers and retain NOT_HUMAN_VALIDATED.
post_processing.failure_cases: reports/failure_cases/development_candidates.json is aligned from existing counterexamples; undefined evidence is not zero-filled.
